description: Implementation of the BoschSimpleList class managing a linked list for sensor data buffering, including methods for adding, retrieving, mounting, and cleaning list nodes.

classes.name: BoschSimpleList
classes.description: A class providing a linked list implementation for sensor data management with capacity control.

methods.name: BoschSimpleList
methods.description: Constructor initializing the list with default capacity.

methods.name: set_uplimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of nodes the list can hold.

methods.name: list_add_rear
methods.description: Adds a new data node at the end of the list.

methods.name: list_get_headdata
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the head data node from the list.

methods.name: list_mount_rear
methods.description: Appends another list to the end of this list, maintaining capacity limits.

methods.name: list_clean
methods.description: Removes all nodes and frees associated memory.
